header.title: Float
header.description: Constant levitation. `variant` picks the path, `trigger` when it runs and `amplitude` how high it rises (when omitted, `intensity` sets it). A ground shadow shrinks as the content rises. With `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` the content stays still.

playground.title: Playground
playground.description: Combine the props and see the generated code. `amplitude` set to `auto` lets `intensity` define the travel.

variants.title: Variants
variants.description: `bob` is a vertical sine (the default), `sway` adds a slight roll, `drift` traces a slow ellipse, `lift` grows as it rises, `idle` is a short rest bob for icons and avatars, `figure8` traces a figure eight, `pendulum` swings in an arc and `orbit` circles around rest. The slower ones use a longer `duration`.

tile.title: On a block
tile.description: A block with `variant="drift"` and `intensity="lg"`. It only moves with `transform`, so it doesn't affect the surrounding layout.

triggers.title: Hover and click
triggers.description: With `trigger="hover"` it floats while the pointer (or focus) is over it. With `click`, each click toggles it on or off. At rest, the content returns to its place.

duration.title: Duration
duration.description: `duration` is one full cycle in milliseconds. Higher values give a calmer motion.

intensity.title: Intensity
intensity.description: When `amplitude` is omitted, `intensity` sets the vertical travel (`sm` 6 px, `md` 10 px, `lg` 16 px). It also scales the roll of `sway` and the sideways drift of `drift`. It takes a token or a number between `0` and `1`.

amplitude.title: Amplitude
amplitude.description: `amplitude` sets the peak travel. A number is pixels; a string is used as is (`"1.25rem"`). It overrides `intensity` for the vertical travel only.

shadow.title: Shadow
shadow.description: The ground shadow shrinks and fades as the content rises. `shadow={false}` removes it.

asChild.title: asChild
asChild.description: With `asChild`, the effect is applied to the child without a wrapping `div`. Here, a gem-system `Button` with `variant="sway"` and `trigger="hover"`. The shadow would mount inside the child and move with it, so this example turns it off with `shadow={false}`.

state.title: Paused and disabled
state.description: `isPaused` freezes the current pose. `isDisabled` stops the float and returns the content to its place, which stays interactive.

callbacks.title: Events
callbacks.description: `onFloat` fires when the float starts and `outFloat` when it stops, with the cause in `event.reason`. The motion doesn't block interaction: the button still gets clicks.

header.title: Float API
header.description: Reference for the props, inheritance, accessibility, CSS classes and variables, and exported types of `Float`.

demos.title: Demos
demos.description: Playground and examples of each variant and trigger.

import.title: Import
import.description: Import it from `@gem-org/gemffects/float` with its `float.css`, or from the root if you already load `styles.css`.

inheritance.title: Inheritance
inheritance.body: Accepts the attributes of HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement> and passes them to the root div (or to the child, with asChild). onClick, onPointerEnter and onPointerLeave run before the effect's internal logic.

items.hidden: The shadow has aria-hidden and pointer-events: none. The motion is transform only: the child keeps receiving clicks and focus.
items.reducedMotion: With prefers-reduced-motion: reduce the content stays still and the shadow stays fixed.
items.ignoreReducedMotion: ignoreReducedMotion (or the gemfx-ignore-reduced-motion class on an ancestor) forces the animation. Only use it if the motion is essential.
items.autoplay: With trigger="always" the motion starts on its own and never ends. WCAG 2.2.2 requires a way to pause automatic motion that lasts more than five seconds: offer a control that sets isPaused, or use hover/click.
items.focus: With trigger="hover" it also floats on keyboard focus (:focus-visible on the root or inside), so it shows while tabbing. A mouse click that focuses a button doesn't keep it floating. onFloat only fires with the pointer.
items.click: With trigger="click", the toggle listens to the root's click. If the child is a button, it also responds to Enter and Space.
items.meaning: Levitation is decoration: don't use it as the only state signal (featured, new). Pair it with text or an ARIA attribute.

items.variant: Active variant. Picks the `@keyframes` of the surface and the shadow.
items.trigger: Active trigger (`always` adds no class). Keeps the surface still until hover/focus or click.
items.inactive: Added with `isActive={false}` or `isDisabled`; keeps the surface still.
items.disabled: Added with `isDisabled`. Removes the pointer cursor.
items.surface: Wraps the child and is what moves (`transform`).
items.shadow: Ground shadow, below the surface. Only with `shadow`.

cssVariables.title: CSS variables
cssVariables.description: `duration`, `delay`, `amplitude`, `drift` and `tilt` are always written inline on the root: use the props to change them. `--gemfx-float-shadow` isn't written inline, so a class can override it.

items.duration: One full cycle. Set by `duration`; default `2800ms`.
items.delay: Delay before starting. Set by `delay`; default `0ms`.
items.amplitude: Peak vertical travel. Set by `amplitude` or, if missing, `intensity`; default `10px`.
items.drift: Sideways drift of `drift`, `figure8` and `pendulum`. Set by `intensity`; default `7px`.
items.tilt: Roll angle of `sway` and `pendulum`. Set by `intensity`; default `2.2deg`.

tokens.title: Tokens
tokens.description: Global variables Float reads as defaults.

items.easingLinear: Curve for `figure8` and `orbit`, so the loop keeps an even speed.

content.title: Content
content.description: Which content levitates and where the effect is mounted.

timing.title: Timing
timing.description: Cycle duration and delay, in milliseconds.

state.title: Trigger and state
state.description: When it levitates and how it's paused or turned off.

items.asChild: Applies the effect to the only child, without a wrapping `div`. Every variant, trigger and state applies the same. The shadow sits inside the child and moves with it, so `shadow={false}` usually fits better. With `shadow` and a void element (`img`, `input`) it falls back to the `div`.
items.amplitude: Peak vertical travel. A number is pixels; a string is used as is. When omitted, `intensity` sets it: `6`, `10` or `16` px.
items.intensity: Scales the travel (if `amplitude` is missing), the roll and the sideways drift. A token or a number between `0` and `1`.
items.shadow: Ground shadow that shrinks as the content rises.
items.duration: One full cycle. Negative values are treated as `0`.
items.trigger: `always` always floats, `hover` while the pointer or focus is over it, `click` toggles with each click.
items.isActive: Allows the float. With `false` it stops and `outFloat` gets `inactive`.
items.isDisabled: Stops the float; the child stays interactive. `outFloat` gets `disabled`.
items.ignoreReducedMotion: Animates even if the user prefers reduced motion. Only if the motion is essential.
items.onFloat: Fires when the float starts: on mount with `always`, on pointer enter with `hover` or when toggled on with `click`.
items.outFloat: Fires when it stops: on pointer leave, when toggled off with `click`, on disable or on unmount.
items.style: Inline styles for the root. Merged with the `--gemfx-float-*` variables.
items.ref: Ref to the root (the `div`, or the child with `asChild`).
